rules.title: CUPS cups-browsed UDP 631 Remote Code Execution Chain
rules.description: cups-browsed binds to UDP INADDR_ANY:631 without authentication and parses untrusted IPP packet headers, triggering foomatic-rip command execution via CVE-2024-47076, CVE-2024-47175, and CVE-2024-47177.
rules.remediation: Stop and disable cups-browsed service: 'sudo systemctl stop cups-browsed && sudo systemctl disable cups-browsed'. Alternatively, drop incoming UDP packets to port 631 via iptables/nftables.

rules.title: CUPS Web Administration Interface Exposed
rules.description: The CUPS administrative web portal is accessible over HTTP on port 631 without requiring TLS mutual authentication, potentially exposing print server configuration and active job histories.
rules.remediation: Enforce 'DefaultEncryption Required' in /etc/cups/cupsd.conf and restrict '<Location /admin>' to authorized administrator CIDRs only.

rules.title: PJL Raw Port 9100 Unauthenticated Command Access
rules.description: The target accepts raw TCP connections on port 9100 and processes Printer Job Language (@PJL) commands without authentication, allowing unauthenticated file extraction, environment manipulation, and print job interception.
rules.remediation: Isolate printers onto a dedicated, non-routable printer VLAN. Restrict port 9100 access to authorized print servers only, and disable PJL in the printer's embedded web server (EWS) where supported.

rules.title: PostScript Device Filesystem / Operator Access
rules.description: The PostScript interpreter supports unconstrained file operators (%rom%, %ram%, %disk%), enabling read and write access to printer internal storage.
rules.remediation: Configure PostScript execution policies to disable direct filesystem operator access, set an administrative PostScript password, or transition to secure IPP-only print rendering.

rules.title: SNMP Agent Responds with Default Community String
rules.description: The device responds to SNMP queries using the default 'public' community string, disclosing serial numbers, network configurations, firmware levels, and active queue telemetry.
rules.remediation: Disable SNMPv1/v2c on the device. Transition to SNMPv3 with SHA authentication and AES encryption, or assign an unpredictable, complex community string.

rules.title: IPP Get-Printer-Attributes Open Disclosure
rules.description: Internet Printing Protocol (IPP) on port 631 answers Get-Printer-Attributes without credentials, disclosing internal hostname, exact firmware build, and supported PDLs.
rules.remediation: Require TLS 1.3 for all IPP connections (IPPS on port 443) and enable user authentication for printer attribute queries.
